text:
Emma: quick check — we have two pending docs PRs that need reviewers and a merge slot today. one is the SDK examples cleanup, the other is the migration notes for v0.9 -> v1.0. who can take which?
Raj: I can look at the SDK examples, but I need the docs preview to be green first. last time snippets lost formatting.
Sophia: I can review the migration notes. heads-up: there are a few deprecated API links that need confirmation from eng-runtime.
Marcus: i'm out until 3pm PT, but i can do a quick link audit after. can we aim to merge between 4–5pm? that slot works for deploy team.
docs-bot: docs preview created: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/67 — SDK examples (PR #1248) and migration (PR #1249).
ci-bot: SDK examples preview shows a build warning: `snippets/py/README.md: line 42: code block fenced incorrectly` — render failed.
Raj: ok i'll fix the fencing now, pushing a tiny commit.
Emma: great. Sophia, can you start the migration review while Raj fixes the snippet formatting? if eng-runtime confirmation is needed, tag @Marcus in the PR thread.
Sophia: doing a quick pass now. found two references to `legacyClient.connect()` — should be `Client.connect()` in examples. adding inline comments.
Raj: pushed fix for fencing. preview updated: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/68 — looks better on mobile. :thumbsup:
Marcus: @Sophia flagged the runtime call — that was intentionally aliased in the old code, but new clients removed alias. i'll add a note in the runtime repo and ack the change.
Emma: decision for reviewer ownership: Raj takes SDK examples, Sophia owns migration notes, Marcus does post-merge link verification. i'll mark them in the PR with `/assign @Raj` and `/assign @Sophia` so the merge bot knows.
Raj: can we add label `merge-slot:4pm` to both PRs so release tooling can queue them?
Emma: yes — i'll add labels and request merge hold until 4:00 PT.
Sophia: all comments addressed on migration PR, requesting a final quickscan from @Marcus once he's back.
ci-bot: migration preview passed build checks.
Marcus: back now, skimmed the migration doc — approved from my side, links look good.
Emma: perfect. Rafa (release bot) will do the gated merge at 4pm. thanks all — if anything blocks, drop a one-liner here.
Raj: ready for merge.
Sophia: ready.
Emma: merging window confirmed 16:00 PT. :party_parrot:
